I’ll continue the approved Muntara plan. First, check Task 2’s brief, then hand it to its implementer.

Task 2’s brief lacks the source notes. I’m adding official-source leads and constraints, then starting the inventory and importer work.

Source notes are in the worktree; the importer and inventory are underway. Task 1’s database checks remain unverified without a local Postgres runtime.

The importer’s TDD cases are now drafted. Next comes validation, upsert logic, and the sourced pilot records.

The 27-record pilot data file is drafted. I’m waiting on its inventory notes and final validation before review.

Task 2 is committed. I’m preparing an independent review against its task brief and checking the report.

Task 2 review passed. I’m recording that result and preparing Task 3’s brief before replacing mock reads.

Task 3 needs a compatibility choice: prototype routes still use mock reads. The implementer will move public browse/detail to Supabase and leave mock exports until Task 5 removes those routes.

Supabase read mapping is in place. I’m waiting for the explore/detail UI conversion and build/lint checks.

Task 3’s query and page checks pass. The implementer is recording a pre-existing dark-mode contrast issue for the later shell task.

Task 3 is committed. I’m preparing its independent review; live Supabase behavior remains an open check.

The Task 3 review is checking mapping, filters, evidence labels, and null-location handling. No live database is available to validate its queries.

Task 3 review passed. For the pilot map, I’m choosing configurable OpenStreetMap tiles with visible attribution; official policy says best-effort, with no SLA.

# Task 2 official-source research leads

Checked 2026-10-27. These are starting points, not a complete or field-verified inventory. Preserve each source period and leave uncertain facts null. A listing from an official page is not proof that its entrance or coordinates were field-checked.

## Official source index

- City departments: https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/
- Tunasan barangay profile: https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/barangays/brgy-tunasan/
- Poblacion barangay profile: https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/barangays/brgy-poblacion/
- City GIS catalogue: https://cgis.muntinlupacity.gov.ph/catalogue/
- DepEd current Muntinlupa dashboard: https://nid.deped.gov.ph/public-dashboard/region/NCR/division/Muntinlupa%20City
- DepEd SY 2020-21 schools/address masterlist: https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/SY-2020-2021-Masterlist-of-Schools-Address-only-1-1.pdf
- DepEd 2026 PPP school-location list: https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/Deped-Announcement-on-PPP-Indicative-List-of-Schools-Annex-A-2025-12-08_1.pdf
- DepEd 2026 allocation list: https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/Annex-B_Allocation-List_2026-B1-CB-007.pdf
- DepEd SDO directory: https://www.deped.gov.ph/contact-us/regional-division-offices-directory/
- DOH Tunasan Health Center: https://ntp.doh.gov.ph/view-facility/?id=13140
- DOH health-center results incl. Poblacion/Southville: https://ntp.doh.gov.ph/resources/facilities/?FacilitySearch%5Btype_id%5D=5&yiiwp-page=104

Use `sourceType: official` for these pages. Set `checkedAt` to `2026-10-27` for facts checked on this date; include publication period in `sourceName` when using older records. Do not label directory evidence as a field visit.

## Candidate public-facing government offices

Only include a place when its physical location is inside Tunasan or Poblacion. This list is not a completeness claim; reconcile it with barangays and city offices. Office addresses, phones, emails, and services below came from official city/agency pages checked 2026-10-27.

### Tunasan

- City Health Office — Centennial Avenue, Laguerta, Brgy. Tunasan, Muntinlupa City 1773; (02) 8541-3485. City health programs; oversees city health centers. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/city-health-office/
- Business Permits and Licensing Office — Right Wing, Muntinlupa Sports Complex, Tunasan (temporary); 8867-6527 / 8862-2756; bplo.muntinlupa@yahoo.com. Business and occupational permits. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/business-permits-and-licensing-office/
- Environmental Sanitation Center — Arandia St.; 8861-1866 / 8862-0352. Environmental sanitation services. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/environmental-sanitation-center/
- Early Childhood Education Division — 2F Laguerta Bulilit Center, Centennial Avenue, Laguerta; 8741-7326; ecedmuntinlupa@gmail.com. Early childhood care/education and center registration/recognition. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/early-childhood-education-division/
- City Security Office — 2nd Floor Motorpool Building, Pacwood Site; (02) 8553-7248; cso.muntinlupa@gmail.com. Public safety/security services. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/city-security-office/
- Muntinlupa City Department of Disaster Resilience and Management — Hall of Justice Compound, Resilience Building, Susana Heights; (02) 8925-4382; drrmomuntinlupa@gmail.com. Disaster preparedness and public assistance. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/muntinlupa-city-department-of-disaster-resilience-and-management/
- Museo ng Muntinlupa — Centennial Ave.; 8256-3128 local 100; museo@muntinlupacity.gov.ph. Public cultural/educational venue. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/museo-ng-muntinlupa/
- Youth Affairs and Sports Development Office — Muntinlupa Sports Center, Buendia St.; 0968-132-4742. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/youth-affairs-and-sports-development-office-yasdo/
- Barangay Tunasan office — official barangay profile lists services and public phones but no street address. Do not invent address or coordinates. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/barangays/brgy-tunasan/

### Poblacion

- Muntinlupa City Public Library — 2nd Floor Plaza Central Building; Mon-Fri except holidays, 7:00-18:00; 8800-8187; mcpubliclibrary1@gmail.com. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/muntinlupa-city-public-library/
- Muntinlupa Scholarship Division — 2nd floor Plaza Central Building; 8831-5971; concerns.msd@gmail.com. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/muntinlupa-scholarship-division/
- Local Economic and Investment Promotion Office — 3rd Floor Plaza Central, Poblacion, Muntinlupa City 1776; 8862-2525 loc. 1032/1033; leipo@muntinlupacity.gov.ph. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/local-economic-and-investment-promotion-office-leipo/
- Public Order and Safety Office — 3rd Floor Plaza Central Bldg., National Road; 0938-432-5000; posomuntinlupa2013@gmail.com. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/public-order-and-safety-office-poso/
- Muntinlupa City Technical Institute Annex — MCTI-Annex Bldg., Phase 2 Block 3 Lot 1 Southville III; 8821-0701 / 8821-0779. Public technical-vocational training. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/muntinlupa-city-technical-institute/
- Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Muntinlupa — University Road, NBP Reservation, Poblacion, Muntinlupa City 1776; (02) 8893-3368 loc. 250; plmuncomm@plmun.edu.ph. Public university. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/departments-offices/pamantasan-ng-lungsod-ng-muntinlupa-plmun/
- DepEd Schools Division Office Muntinlupa — Laguerta St., Tensuan Site, Poblacion; (02) 8865-1514, 8861-4953, 8829-2308, 8478-2846; sdo.muntinlupa@gmail.com. https://www.deped.gov.ph/contact-us/regional-division-offices-directory/
- Barangay Poblacion office — official barangay profile lists services, four phone lines, and official email but no street address. Do not invent address or coordinates. https://muntinlupacity.gov.ph/barangays/brgy-poblacion/

Do not include Colegio de Muntinlupa: official city page places it in Sucat, outside the pilot. Do not assume the city-departments list is exhaustive; reconcile public counters and national-agency sites with barangays.

## Public health facilities

- Tunasan Health Center — DOH NTP record identifies E. Rodriguez Ave., Tunasan (beside barangay hall), facility type Rural Health Unit/Health Center. https://ntp.doh.gov.ph/view-facility/?id=13140
- Poblacion Health Center — DOH facility listing gives Ground Floor, Contessa Bldg., Poblacion, Rizal St.
- Southville Health Center — DOH facility listing gives Phase 1 Insular Prison Rd., South Ville 3, Poblacion.

Both Poblacion locations are distinct. Do not duplicate a clinic because separate TB/DOTS/iDOTS program rows refer to the same facility. Verify candidate barangay placement and current operation; DOH NTP is a facility lead, not proof of current hours or all offered services.

## Public schools and learning centers

The current DepEd Muntinlupa dashboard lists 28 city schools but does not provide addresses. The older SY 2020-21 address masterlist gives these pilot candidates; keep the source period visible:

- Muntinlupa Elementary School (136903) — Rizal Street, Poblacion.
- Tunasan Elementary School (136906) — Arandia St., Tunasan.
- Victoria Homes Elementary School (136907) — Don Pedro Reyes Ave., Victoria Homes Subdivision, Tunasan.
- Poblacion Elementary School (228501) — Phase 1 Southville 3, Poblacion.

The DepEd 2026 PPP list supplies official project coordinates, not on-site verification:

- Muntinlupa ES (136903): 14.3891958, 121.0442405.
- Tunasan ES (136906): 14.3811, 121.0516.

The 2026 DepEd allocation list gives Muntinlupa NHS (305468), NBP Reservation, Poblacion; Muntinlupa Science HS (305469), Arandia St., Tunasan; Poblacion National HS (320701), Southville 3, NHA, Poblacion; and Tunasan National HS (320704), Old PNB Bldg., National Road, Muntinlupa City. Keep coordinates null unless an official source gives them. Do not include Tunasan National HS until its physical barangay is confirmed; its name is not enough. Do not add Itaas ES while its exact current address remains unconfirmed. Do not duplicate the old “Muntinlupa NHS-Tunasan Annex” record against the current dashboard without reconciliation.

ECED city page confirms the division and its role but does not provide a current public list of child-development centers. Record this as a coverage gap; do not invent centers.

## Inventory safeguards

- Pilot means every public-facing government office, public clinic, and public school physically inside Tunasan or Poblacion, including barangay offices and national-agency service points. Listing every candidate above does not establish completeness.
- Null uncertain address, location, contact, schedule, service, or access facts. Never derive a location from a barangay label or building name alone.
- Every non-null fact needs field-level source evidence in the JSON. For older DepEd addresses, source name must state `SY 2020-2021`; the 2026 project coordinates must state the PPP list source and must not imply a visit.
- OSM may support only `location`, clearly labeled `openstreetmap`, with attribution. Never use OSM to assert services, hours, operation, or accessibility.
- Do not include private facilities, employee names, personal contacts, offices without public visitors, or facilities outside the two barangays.
- Keep public coverage label “pilot listings in progress” until barangays/facility owners reconcile gaps.

## Provider decision and current usage policy

Use the standard OpenStreetMap raster tile service as the configurable pilot default. Policy checked 2026-10-27: `https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/`.

- Interactive viewport requests only. Never prefetch, bulk-download, or offer offline tiles. Let the browser honor caching headers and default Referer behavior.
